text: 【央行副行长陶玲：支持更多境外投资者以适当方式投资境内股债资产】2026年10月16日，中国人民银行党委委员、副行长陶玲在全球财富管理论坛·上海苏河湾大会上就推进人民币国际化、畅通人民币国际使用循环发表演讲。
text_en: [PBOC Deputy Governor Tao Ling: Support more overseas investors in investing in domestic equity and bond assets in appropriate ways] On October 16, 2026, Tao Ling, member of the Party Committee and Deputy Governor of the People's Bank of China, delivered a speech on advancing RMB internationalization and facilitating the international use circulation of the RMB at the Global Wealth Management Forum · Shanghai Suhewan Conference.
